name: crypto-strategy-lab
description: Platform for combining, backtesting and ranking crypto trading strategies

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "blue,green" "pnpm --dir apps/api dev" "pnpm --dir apps/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir packages/contracts build && pnpm --dir apps/api build && pnpm --dir apps/web build
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir apps/api lint && pnpm --dir apps/web lint && pnpm --dir apps/web lint:ui
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:contracts
